name: Irreversible sibling artifact commit must follow complete preparation

payload.contract: For a multi-artifact operation, every sibling must be prepared and a recovery owner established before the first irreversible publish. Cleanup after publish must not destroy the only recovery source.
search_shape: two or more sibling durable artifacts
first artifact becomes externally visible before later sibling terminal action
error path returns and cleans remaining local state
admission_gate: prove cleanup cannot undo published artifact
name retained or destroyed recovery source
payload.stop_rule: do not enumerate error types after one before/after-boundary matrix proves the ordering root
